text: From 2020 to 2024, I had the honor of serving as your City Councilmember from east side Gilroy, now District 6. I am a fourth generation Gilroyan, and chose to raise my own family here, because I am deeply committed to ensuring that our hardworking families feel proud and secure in their neighborhoods. I believe our City needs to invest in our Districts infrastructure, such as improved street lighting and landscaping, and pedestrian and traffic safety initiatives. When we are proud of our neighborhood, no matter which side of town we live on, our whole City benefits. As a co-founder of Gilroy Growing Smarter, I advocate for building housing responsibly, so younger generations and long-time residents can afford to stay and put down roots here, too. As part of CARAS, I have the privilege of working with young people on life skills, leadership development and positive decision making. Throughout my life, I have been a dedicated advocate for our community, and I am asking for your support to continue this work, for our District and for our City. Please join me in shaping our future—I respectfully ask for your vote for Rebeca Armendariz for Gilroy City Council, District 6.

text: My name is Brad Starks, and I am proud to call Gilroy home. I have spent many years working in corporate marketing, where I have learned the value of listening, solving problems, and bringing people together to find practical solutions.

My wife, Nirza, is an elementary school teacher, and together we are raising our two children, Cooper (15) and Casey (10), in Gilroy. Our family, including our dog Rocky, is deeply invested in our community and its future.

I am running for City Council because I believe Gilroy deserves leadership that listens, respects different perspectives, and works collaboratively to solve problems. As our city continues to grow and face new challenges, I will work to ensure every resident's voice is heard while building common ground to move Gilroy forward.

I believe in transparency, accountability, and respectful leadership. I am committed to making thoughtful decisions that support safe neighborhoods, strong local businesses, quality services, and opportunities for every family.
It would be an honor to earn your vote and serve the community that my family and I proudly call home.

text: I am honored to have the opportunity to become your representative for District 6.

Utilizing with my business experience, I can partner with current leaders to make common sense decisions that will have generational impacts. Furthermore, I believe I can help represent our younger citizens and provide a new outlook in the Council Chambers.

I am fourth generation Gilroyan and proudly returned home after completing my undergraduate degree in Sacramento studying Public Policy. As a young professional, I attend many community events where I have been able to network with past and current elected and appointed leaders of our community.

As part of my studies, I was blessed with the opportunity to work with our youth through National Night Out and Youth Taskforce events and hope to be the first of many young people becoming involved in our community's leadership roles.

I am humbly asking for your vote in order to usher in a new generation of leaders and moving our city forward. I hope to represent our district as a whole with common sense stances while building trust and protecting future generations.

With gratitude,
Elizabeth Bracco, City Council District 6 Candidate
